items.title: Complete Propane Cylinder Supply Solution
items.desc: Equipment stability directly affects welding and cutting work efficiency.
body: For craftsmen who weld, repair and fabricate metal every day, stable gas equipment directly affects work quality and speed.
Wanda Groups propane cylinders are available from 3L to 50L with POL, CGA 510 or GOST valves depending on your market — one supplier for welding, cutting and heating.
We recommend ordering cylinders together with regulators, hoses and torches. Bundle supply reduces logistics cost and ensures accessory compatibility.
When ordering, specify target market, volume, valve type and color — we prepare OEM marking and export packaging under your brand.

items.title: Long-Term Acetylene Cylinder Storage Tips
items.desc: Storage conditions, placement methods and regular inspections for unused cylinders.
body: Many companies store acetylene and propane cylinders during production breaks or as inventory. Unused cylinders still require proper handling.
Store cylinders upright in a well-ventilated area away from heat sources and direct sunlight. Storage temperature should typically not exceed 40–50°C.
Inspect valves, caps and markings at least quarterly. For long-term acetylene storage, keep cylinders vertical and never allow tilting.
Wanda Groups ships cylinders with protective caps and export packaging designed for safe transport and warehousing. Storage guides are available in your language on request.

privacy.label: Legal
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: Wanda Groups (“we”, “us”) operates this website to present gas cylinders, accessories and related export supply, and to receive commercial inquiries from industrial buyers.

This policy explains what personal data we collect through the site, why we use it, and how you can contact us about it. Factory production videos are shown on this website. Certificate files are sent privately on request.

sections.title: Who is responsible
body: The controller of personal data collected via this website is Wanda Groups. For privacy requests write to sales@wandagroups.com.

sections.title: What data we collect
body: When you send the inquiry form we receive the data you enter: name, email, phone, destination country, product type, quantity and message.
The site also stores your language choice in the browser (localStorage). We do not run advertising cookies or sell visitor lists.

sections.title: Why we use the data
body: We use inquiry data only to reply to your request, prepare a quotation, send product information, videos or certificates that you asked for, and to coordinate an order if we start working together.
Legal basis: your consent when you tick the checkbox on the form, and our legitimate interest in answering B2B sales requests.

sections.title: Who receives the data
body: Your message is delivered to our sales team by email. The form is processed by Web3Forms, a technical provider that transmits the message to us.
We do not sell personal data. We may share what is needed with logistics, inspection or banking partners only if that is required to fulfil an agreed order.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Inquiry data is kept for as long as needed to handle the request and for a reasonable period afterwards for sales follow-up and accounting, unless you ask us to delete it earlier where the law allows.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You may ask for a copy of the data we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. You may withdraw consent for further marketing-style follow-up by writing to us. To exercise these rights, email sales@wandagroups.com.

sections.title: Security and children
body: We take reasonable technical and organisational steps to protect messages in transit and in our mailbox. This website is intended for business buyers, not for children.

sections.title: What the website is for
body: The site presents product information and receives commercial inquiries. It is intended for business buyers, not for consumers shopping as private individuals and not for children.
